Title: Document 1
Content: Source: E. E. Cooper, African American editor of the Washington, D.C., newspaper Colored American, newspaper articles, `text(1898)`.

`text(March 19)`: [The war with Spain will result in a] quickened sense of our duty toward `text(one)` another, and a loftier conception of the obligations of government to its humblest citizen. . . . `text(April 30)`: [Black participation in the war will bring about] an era of good feeling the country over and cement the races into a more compact brotherhood through perfect unity of purpose and patriotic affinity [where White people will] . . . unloose themselves from the bondage of racial prejudice.
